data.name: Curious Comedy Showdown

description.name: description
description.body:
Welcome to the Hunger Games of Comedy. Six players enter the stage. Only one will survive. Curious Comedy Showdown pits Portland’s finest comedians against one another in a competitive improv comedy cage match that will make you laugh until you cry. 

Armed only with razor-sharp wit and your suggestions, the players must create fast-paced and hilarious scenes on the spot to win audience votes – round after round – in hopes of living to see another day. Finally, you decide which player is left standing. If you like Whose Line Is It Anyway, then you’ll love this show!

You can watch our long-running flagship improv show in person at our beautiful cabaret-style main stage venue in Northeast Portland, Oregon – or – watch the slick-as-hell livestream from home with your dog on your lap. Either way, you’re going to have a good time.

If you’re looking for an alternative to the same old options – like bars, bowling, or a movie – then you’ve found it! Curious Comedy Showdown is a Portland favorite for first dates and date nights, birthday parties, bachelorette parties, company events, team bonding, and girls-night-out! Without a doubt, this show is one of the most fun and unique things to do in Portland.

Delicious food. Full bar. Big laughs. In a word? Joy.

A fast-paced, crowd-sourced, D&D Improv Show.

Welcome to Side Quest! Curious Comedy's very own D&D improv show. Our cast of Curious Characters will roll their way through a story made up on the spot by the Game Master and you!

We'll crowd-source the adventure for each unique show with your audience suggestions and votes. Then watch the story unfold! The world's greatest role playing game meets the other world's greatest role playing game in a fast-paced, no-stakes epic of grown-ups playing make-believe in silly outfits.

Grab your tickets now and make history at the 1st season ever of Side Quest

This show will be in the Curious Annex which has snacks, beer, wine, and cider for you to indulge in as you watch the show!

data.name: LGBTQIA+ IMPROV JAM!

description.name: description
description.body:
A FREE LGBTQIA+ Improv Social every 2nd Sunday 3-5PM in the Curious Comedy Annex Theater.

Show up at 3PM to meet new folks and sign up to play fun and social improv games with the support of theater veterans. Play or just show up to watch, and stay for an after-jam social with complimentary snacks and drinks.* 

ALL AGES AND EXPERIENCE LEVELS are WELCOME! 

This event is facilitated by LGBTQ2SIA+ members for the LGBTQ2SIA+ community. 

This is a closed event for LGBTQ2SIA+ only. (We love you allies! Please support us by sharing the event and not attending.)

The LGBTQ2SIA+ community includes:

  • Lesbian
  • Gay
  • Bisexual
  • Transgender/non-binary
  • Queer/Questioning
  • 2 Two-Spirit
  • Intersex
  • Asexual
  • + Other marginalized gender identities & sexual orientations
Curious Comedy Annex, 5229 NE MLK #102

Please send any questions to Skel Harrington at skel@curiouscomedy.org

*This event does not include alcoholic drinks, but there are a number of bars in close walking distance to the theater for anyone who wants to start the afterparty.

DETAILS:

The Annex Theater
Doors at 2:30 pm. Show at 3:00 pm.
Advanced Ticket: free
Door Ticket:  free


MASK AND VACCINE POLICY:
At this time we are not requiring proof of vaccination or masks to attend our shows and events. We strongly encourage those who can get vaccinated to do so for your safety and the safety of others. If you feel more comfortable wearing a mask, we encourage you to do so. Many of our staff are still choosing to wear masks, so it's likely you will not be the only one in a mask. We support you taking whatever precautions feel right to you!

data.name: Open Court - Improv Jam

description.name: description
description.body:
Portland’s longest running improv jam, Open Court is beloved, fun, supportive, and open to all!

What happens when improvisers of all levels of skill and experience, from all different theaters and troupes, from Portland and beyond, come together to perform long-form improv comedy for each other and the audience? FUN!

Everyone is welcome to play in Open Court whether you have been playing for years or have never been on a stage before in your life. Teams are picked randomly and coached by supportive, experienced improvisers from the Curious Comedy Company. We warm up in our teams and then perform for each other and the audience.

Just want to watch? That’s great! No pressure to play - not ever!

Curious Comedy’s longest running show, Open Court is close to our hearts. A great place to play, to meet people, and to see what Curious Comedy is all about!

data.name: Croatian Roots, American Problems - Stand Up Comedy Show

description.name: description
description.body:
A standup comedy show by two touring Croatian-American comedians.

Croatian Roots, American Problems is a standup show brought to you by Stanko Zovak and George Dulcich. Stanko is a Los Angeles comedian who once quit his job, moved to Croatia, and spent three years learning the language just to understand his family better. (It only made them seem crazier.) He’s back in LA performing standup all over the country, running the hit series Last Band Standing, and hosting the All Things Croatia Podcast. George is a Croatian American comedian from Los Angeles. He’s 75% Dalmatinac and 25% Hercegovac which means he’ll 100% have a drink with you after the show! George’s comedy blends elements of self-mockery, family dynamics and cultural mishaps. George has performed all over the United States as well as Croatia.

Croatian Roots, American Problems so far has been to Seattle, Denver, and Philadelphia. Portland is going to be another fun one! Bring your Croatian friends and bring your American friends too! There will be plenty of jokes for everyone!

data.name: Round Trip

description.name: description
description.body:
ROUND TRIP: An Interactive Improv Adventure

Pack your bags for an hour-long comedy journey that puts YOU in control!

ROUND TRIP features two of Portland's most exciting improv teams taking you on wildly different adventures. From mind-bending time travel to the hilarious chaos of group getaways, this interactive experience proves that the best destinations are the ones you create together.

What to Expect:
Forward Slash - Watch Kyle Stebbins and Nate Smith bend time itself as YOU control the timeline with "forward slash" and "back slash" commands, jumping through the past, present, and future of any story.

Ladies Trip - Portland favorites KT Behrens, Audrey Butler, Alex Disney, and Willow McCormick take your destination suggestions and show you what REALLY happens when friends travel together - from spa retreats to music festivals and everywhere in between.

Every show is completely improvised and shaped by audience participation. Your suggestions guide the journey. No two trips are ever the same!

Follow us!
@ladiestripimprov
@forwardslashimprov

This show is in the CURIOUS COMEDY ANNEX
